services.name: Paddle & Pedal
services.desc: Information Spend a day out at the lake! Kayak to the end of Eklutna Lake, where you will have bikes waiting for the return trip! This adventure is 8 miles one-way by kayak, and 9 miles one-way by bike. Due to the sheer size and the wind of Eklutna Lake, we require at least 2 people in a party for safety purposes. This trip takes 5 to 7 hours to complete, and pick-up time is 10am to ensure you return before closing. In compliance with Eklutna Lake's UTV use, this trip is available Sunday - Wednesday only. We need the UTV to get the bikes to the backside of the lake, and to pick up the kayaks. Kayak & Biking Combo · Our most popular option!

services.name: Overnight Bike Rentals
services.desc: If you are looking for overnight bike rentals for your cabin rental, we've got you covered! Overnight rentals are for those who have reserved the Yuditna Creek Cabin, or other campground along the lakeside to include: Bold Airstrip, Alex, Kanchee or Serenity Falls Hut. Bikes are not permitted to be kept in the Eklutna Campground. You can find campsite rental [HERE](https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/chugach-state-park/AK/1180246/campsites). Please make sure you are looking at the rentals on Eklutna Lake. Standard pick-up is 4pm. You can pick up at 10am instead for an additional $50 per Overnight bike rentals for lakeside cabin rentals

services.name: Eklutna Challenge Race
services.desc: On your mark, get set... After a long snowy winter, it is time to break out those running shoes and check the pressure on your bike wheels! Lifetime Adventures is proud to be bringing back the Eklutna Challenge Race this year. Join us at 10am on September 21, 2024 for some heart pumping fun! The last day of early registration is September 14th. Registration after that date is $55. Registration also available day of from 8am-9:30am at Eklutna Lake. Bib pickup information is contained in your confirmation email. All proceeds benefit the Eagle River Nature Center and Alaska Trails. The Route: We're bringing back a classic on 09/21/2024 @ 10:00AM

blurb: Guests can rent bikes and kayaks for 2-8 hours or overnight to explore over 20 miles of recreational trails around Eklutna Lake. Options include guided day tours, overnight adventures, kayaking lessons, and transportation to the back side of the lake. Group outings for up to 110 guests and overnight rentals for state cabins are also available.
